specification.objective: Add local, deterministic, per-store memory diagnostics and manual entry navigation without AI calls or automatic mutations.

requirements.statement: Calculate exact entry counts, used/remaining character counts, long entry indices, exact duplicate groups and an explicit size distribution for each Hermes memory target.
Expose informative size and duplication findings with per-entry navigation in Desktop and no automated deletion, compaction or LLM use.
Handle empty stores, zero character budgets and Unicode safely; label heuristics as indicative, not as objective quality ratings.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression checks known fixtures against exact deterministic metrics for both memory and user including Unicode, duplicates, empty entries and zero budgets.
Desktop navigation contract exposes links to long/duplicate entries and visibly documents informational estimates without automatic mutations or model requests.

invariants.statement: No direct memory file mutation; existing Hermes MemoryStore methods and compaction-save semantics stay unchanged.
Diagnostic counts use Python codepoint lengths and existing store-reported character budgets without sending content to external AI.

forbidden_states.statement: Diagnostic observations trigger write, compaction or AI operations.
Nonsemantic exact duplicate metrics are represented as objective quality/contradiction proof.

inputs.statement: GET /memory store entries, Hermes _char_count and _char_limit metadata.

outputs.statement: Read-only diagnostics object per memory target and navigable UI entries.

failure_semantics.statement: Zero and negative budgets clamp remaining capacity to zero; Unicode and invalid sizes do not crash diagnostic calculation.
